lead: A rule clause mandating a wire feature can be un-implementable for reasons only the sibling driver's code shows.
body: `COM_STMT_BULK_EXECUTE` for MariaDB's `executeMany` was settled against by `crates/nvs-db/src/pg.rs` flushing every `Bind`/`Execute`/`Sync` in one `wire.send` and by `mysql.rs`'s `Prepared` doc saying a prepare reports `0` columns for a data-dependent result set, neither of which the rule mentions. Read the sibling driver and the struct docs before budgeting a feature from the rule's text.
